title: Tau persona-dream harness needs dream-packet creator/reviewer loop
state: OPEN

## Type
feature

## Target
`/home/graham/workspace/experiments/tau`

Concrete areas likely involved:
- `experiments/goal-locked-subagents/agent-command-specs/`
- `src/tau_coding/cli.py`
- `src/tau_coding/persona_dream_panel_proof.py` or a new persona-dream pipeline proof module
- persona-dream work order artifact: `/home/graham/workspace/experiments/tau/experiments/goal-locked-subagents/proofs/issue-39-provider-eligible-final-20260629T195500Z/receipts/dream_packet_work_order.json`

## Current State
Persona-dream full-pipeline validation now prioritizes upstream pipeline health over Kling. The existing Tau persona-dream lane only has panel command specs:

```text
panel-creator
panel-reviewer
persona-dream-panel-repair-gate
```

There is no Tau `dreamer` command spec or creator/reviewer loop that consumes `persona_dream.dream_packet_work_order.v1` and emits a validated `dream_packet.json`.

Local evidence from agent-skills persona-dream:

```text
./run.sh pipeline-loop-status /home/graham/workspace/experiments/tau/experiments/goal-locked-subagents/proofs/issue-39-provider-eligible-final-20260629T195500Z --direction forward --json
# status: BLOCKED
# first_blocker.phase: dream_packet
# first_blocker.reason: missing_artifact
# active_loop.loop: dream_packet_loop
# active_loop.default_repair: Generate or repair the dream packet from current memory residue, contact sheet, frame prompts, and reflection receipts.

./run.sh pipeline-loop-run /home/graham/workspace/experiments/tau/experiments/goal-locked-subagents/proofs/issue-39-provider-eligible-final-20260629T195500Z --direction forward --max-iterations 1 --output /home/graham/workspace/experiments/tau/experiments/goal-locked-subagents/proofs/issue-39-provider-eligible-final-20260629T195500Z/receipts/pipeline_loop_run_forward.json --json
# status: BLOCKED
# stop_reason: work_order_written
# repair_action.status: WROTE_DREAM_PACKET_WORK_ORDER
# repair_action.owner_subagent: dreamer
# repair_action.output: .../receipts/dream_packet_work_order.json

./run.sh validate-dream-packet-work-order /home/graham/workspace/experiments/tau/experiments/goal-locked-subagents/proofs/issue-39-provider-eligible-final-20260629T195500Z/receipts/dream_packet_work_order.json --json
# status: PASS_DREAM_PACKET_WORK_ORDER
# first_blocker: null
# owner_subagent: dreamer
```

## Requested Outcome
Add a Tau persona-dream dream-packet creator/reviewer while-loop path that consumes `persona_dream.dream_packet_work_order.v1`, dispatches through `tau.agent_handoff.v1`, and emits a source-grounded `dream_packet.json` plus receipts that pass persona-dream validation.

The first implementation may be bounded to one run root and one dream packet. It must not call Kling, make paid provider calls, or fabricate memory residue.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Add a routable Tau `dreamer` or equivalent creator/reviewer command spec for `persona_dream.dream_packet_work_order.v1`.
- The command loop writes `tau.agent_handoff.v1` and `tau.subagent_receipt.v1` artifacts for creator and reviewer or an explicit fail-closed reviewer.
- The generated `dream_packet.json` is derived from real memory/residue or fails closed with `no_dream`; fixture residue must be clearly marked as fixture and not used for live proof closure.
- `skills/persona-dream/run.sh validate-dream-packet <dream_packet> --run-root <run_root> --json` returns `PASS_DREAM_PACKET` for the live proof, or a deterministic fail-closed blocker if memory residue is unavailable.
- `skills/persona-dream/run.sh pipeline-loop-status <run_root> --direction forward --json` advances past `dream_packet` to `story_contract` or a later blocker.
- No Kling call, paid provider call, or public upload is performed.

## Required Proof
Attach a proof root under:

```text
experiments/goal-locked-subagents/proofs/<issue-id>-persona-dream-dream-packet-loop-<timestamp>/
```

Required artifacts:
- input `dream_pa
